title: scenarios replay: RecordedDriver createdIdOf reads only a top-level id, so a row created by run_action (result.id) is never remapped and the replayed follow-up operation gets RECORD_NOT_FOUND
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6964820901), from the #34996 loop (area o3-F).

## What happens
In `packages/qa/scenarios`, the RecordedDriver's `createdIdOf` (`src/runner/driver.ts`) reads only a **top-level `id`**. `run_action` answers `{ok, action, objectName, result: {id}}`, so the id of a row an action creates is never remapped on replay.

The replayed `demotravel_submit_claim` then gets `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, and `file_and_submit_from_text` reads NOT MEASURED on every replay regrade. Until this is fixed, the loop's operation score can be graded only offline.

## Done when
- `createdIdOf` also reads the created id from `result.id` on action answers.
- A replay pin covers an action-created row that a later operation reads.

Parent: #34659. Blocks: #34996 (the ask-skill loop's operation target).
Grade: **p1 · domain:devx · area:ai**. It blocks measurement for the maintainer-requested p1 loop.
